          Mode

           

          Colour

          Animations

          Alarm

          The ring plays one lunar cycle in 1 minute, holds a bright full Moon for 10 minutes or until you press the button, then returns to Auto.

          Lamp status

          Update this lamp over Wi-Fi

          Ring LEDs

          Tap an LED

          Ring alignment

          Calibrate lights LED 0 red, 1 green, 2 blue. Enter where LED 0 sits (degrees counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock, as seen from the front) and which way the numbers run.

          Location

          ISS pass alerts · quiet hours

          When the space station passes over, the alarm stays silent inside the shaded hours (sleeping or away). The map still flashes. Drag the two handles, or use the arrow keys.
